name: Ramazonbek Temirov
summary: Uzbek flyweight power puncher (20-3, 3-0 UFC; also billed as Ramazan Temirov) on a 12-fight win streak. Came back from a doping suspension in July to knock out Steve Erceg in round 1; 11 of his 20 wins are first-round finishes.

how_they_fight.Striking: Forward-marching pressure with a heavy right hand: dropped Erceg with the first right he landed, then twice more in the last minute before the finish at 4:21 of R1 (LowKick MMA). Hand-to-hand and karate background. Lower accuracy (43%) but a very high knockdown rate (2.0 per 15 min in a small UFC sample).
how_they_fight.Grappling: Rarely wrestles (about 1 takedown per 15); about 73% takedown defence. One submission win (R1, 2021).
how_they_fight.Defense: About 65% strike defence. Never KO'd; only stopped once (submission R2, 2019). Erceg survived the first knockdown by shooting, so a takedown on the counter is a way to reset him.
how_they_fight.Pace & cardio: A fast starter: 11 R1 finishes and 2 R2 finishes (verified); never finished anyone after round 2. When it goes long he has won decisions (Charles Johnson, 3 rounds, UFC 2025), but his three losses are two 3-round decisions and a R2 submission. Danger is front-loaded: survive R1 and the fight changes.
how_they_fight.Fight IQ: Simple and effective: pressure, right hand, finish. Untested against a high-level grappler in the UFC.

patterns: Walks opponents to the fence behind the right hand
No finishes after round 2 in his career
concerns: Served a one-year suspension (positive test for trimetazidine, per AAP/Rotowire); out about 16-17 months before Erceg
Little wrestling; three-round decision fights are his weakest form
keys_to_beat: Survive round 1: circle off the right hand and clinch or shoot when he loads up
Drag him into rounds 2-3 and make it a volume fight

news.text: Knocked out Steve Erceg at 4:21 of R1 in the UFC Abu Dhabi co-main for Performance of the Night, his first fight back from a PED suspension (17-month layoff per LowKick MMA).
Cageside Press: 'after missing a year of action following a steroid suspension', he delivered the best performance of his career.
Booked against Lone'er Kavanagh at UFC 333.
